description: A dramatic forest-pavilion dining room with a soaring glass curtain wall. Floor-to-ceiling black steel-framed glazing covers the entire rear wall and apparently both side walls, dissolving the boundary between the interior and the lush Pacific Northwest evergreen forest beyond. Tall dark conifer trunks and green forest understory fill the view. A large oval dining table with a creamy bleached travertine or light stone top sits on a sculptural fluted bronze-toned cylindrical pedestal base. Eight upholstered dining chairs in charcoal and putty grey with slim black metal legs surround the table, their low elegant profiles maintaining the clean sight lines to the forest. The floor is a smooth warm concrete or sand-tone stone. The ceiling is a simple white horizontal band above the glazing transom. The room is flooded with cool filtered forest light that creates an atmosphere of contemplative calm. A golden warm glow emanates from the ceiling position above the table, adding warmth to the cool forest light. The mood is architectural, serene, and impressively material.
